summary.name: electerm
summary.one_liner: electerm is a free, open-source terminal and remote-connection client supporting SSH, SFTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, Spice and FTP across desktop and mobile platforms.
use_cases: connect to remote servers over SSH
transfer files with SFTP or Zmodem
manage Telnet or serial port devices
connect to Windows or Linux desktops via RDP or VNC
run terminal sessions on older operating systems
summary.what_it_does: The page describes electerm as an all-in-one client combining a terminal, file manager, and SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC and Spice connections in one app. It lists multi-tab terminals with split panes, SSH features such as publicKey and password auth, proxies, tunneling, agent and X11 forwarding, and connection hopping. It also mentions an AI assistant that works with OpenAI and Anthropic API formats, cloud sync of bookmarks and themes to GitHub/Gitee gists or WebDAV, and Zmodem and Trzsz file transfer. Download options include npm, Homebrew, Snap, Flatpak, and APT/RPM repositories.
notable: Supports many protocols (SSH, SFTP, Telnet, serial, RDP, VNC, Spice, FTP) in one app
Runs on older systems such as Windows 7, macOS 10.15 and Ubuntu 18, plus LoongArch, RISC-V and ppc64le Linux
AI assistant supporting OpenAI and Anthropic API formats, plus MCP and deep links (ssh:// URLs)
caveats: The page mentions a 'Free AI for electerm users' offer, but its terms are not described in the page text
Sponsorship is offered for supporting the project; no paid tiers are described
